title: The Luel data marketplace is becoming agent-native | Luel
summary: Buy and sell datasets through your agent or the console. Rights-cleared conversational speech, now licensable over MCP.
body_markdown:
The Luel data marketplace is becoming agent-native.


You can now browse and license datasets over MCP, or submit your own dataset for review and listing, directly through your agent. The existing console remains available too.


It's the same marketplace, with a second way in — bringing the data our contributor network creates into the workflows where people are already building.


## Buy datasets with your agent


Ask your agent to browse the catalog and license a dataset. Luel Data works over MCP with **Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients** , making dataset discovery and licensing part of the same workflow as the rest of your project.


Authenticate in your browser. No API keys to copy or paste.


You can also browse and license directly from the console. Both routes give you access to the same catalog.


## The data underneath


The data comes from **Luel's network of more than 850,000 contributors across 96+ countries** . That reach lets us collect real speech from the communities that use each language and make it available through a catalog that people and their agents can license.


The conversational speech available today is **cleared and licensed for commercial AI training** .


It comes from paid adult contributors who agreed their recordings can be used to train AI. The data is collected from real people, never synthetically generated, and integrity-checked before delivery.


## Have data to sell?


The same marketplace works the other way around.


Turn high-quality datasets into licensable inventory by submitting them through your agent. Every submission is manually reviewed by Luel before listing, and nothing is priced or published automatically.


You can check the status of your submission at any time.


That opens the marketplace to people and organisations with data to offer, alongside the catalog already available to buyers. The same agent workflow supports both sides: finding data for your project and submitting data for others to license.


## Where this goes next


Agent-native access to the Luel data marketplace is available today.


Browse the catalog, connect your agent or submit a dataset on[Luel Data](https://www.luel.ai/data) .


The research and specialist models built around real-world data continue at[Luel Labs](https://www.luel.ai/lab) and[Luel Speech](https://www.luel.ai/speech) .
